[[File:Sergey Kara-Murza 6 September 2014.JPG|Kara-Murza in 2014|thumb|right|180px]]
'''Sergey Georgyevich Kara-Murza''' ({{langx|ru|Сергей Георгиевич Кара-Мурза}}; 23 January 1939 in Moscow<ref name="auto"/> – 18 October 2025<ref>{{Cite web | title="Это самый великий по мудрости, интеллекту человек уходящей эпохи" | url=https://mkam.business-gazeta.ru/article/685922 | access-date=2025-11-16 | website=mkam.business-gazeta.ru}}</ref>) was a Soviet and Russian chemist,<ref>{{cite book | title=Fortress Russia: Conspiracy Theories in the Post-Soviet World | date=27 August 2018 | publisher=John Wiley & Sons | isbn=978-1-5095-2267-5 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=nA1rDwAAQBAJ&pg=PA55 }}</ref> historian,<ref>{{cite web | last1=Велехов | first1=Леонид | title=Грани Времени. Кубинский Сталин умер. Живо ли его дело? | work=Радио Свобода | url=https://www.svoboda.org/a/28210002.html }}</ref> [[political philosopher]] and sociologist.<ref>{{cite web | title=Скончался социолог и публицист Сергей Кара-Мурза | url=https://ru.apa.az/strani-snq/skoncalsya-sociolog-i-publicist-sergei-kara-murza-624708 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web | title=Стало известно время и место прощания с публицистом Сергеем Кара-Мурзой | url=https://www.business-gazeta.ru/news/685718 | access-date=2025-11-16 | website=Business-gazeta.ru | date=20 October 2025 }}</ref><ref>{{cite book | title=The Shifting Global Balance of Power: Perils of a World War and Preventive Measures | date=9 June 2014 | publisher=Xlibris Corporation | isbn=978-1-4990-2664-1 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=w-rqAwAAQBAJ&pg=PA41 }}</ref> [[Doctor of Sciences]] in Chemical Sciences (1983<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=http://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/6493|title=Кара-Мурза Сергей Георгиевич &#124; Летопись Московского университета|website=letopis.msu.ru}}</ref>),<ref>{{cite web | title=Умер автор книги "Манипуляция сознанием" Сергей Кара-Мурза | work=Радио Свобода | date=18 October 2025 | url=https://www.svoboda.org/a/umer-avtor-knigi-manipulyatsiya-soznaniem-sergey-kara-murza-/33563529.html }}</ref> and professor (1988).<ref name="auto3">{{cite web | title=Умер ученый и публицист Сергей Кара-Мурза | date=18 October 2025 | url=https://www.rbc.ru/society/18/10/2025/68f368859a794734a197ba98 }}</ref> He was the chief researcher of the [[Institute of Socio-Political Research]].<ref name="auto1">{{Cite web|url=https://xn--h1aauh.xn--p1ai/%D1%81%D0%B2%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B9-%D0%BF%D0%B0%D0%BC%D1%8F%D1%82%D0%B8-%D1%81-%D0%B3-%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B0-%D0%BC%D1%83%D1%80%D0%B7%D1%8B-1939-2025/|title=Светлой памяти С.Г. Кара-Мурзы (23.01.1939-18.10.2025)… — ИСПИ ФНИСЦ РАН|website=Xn--h1aauh.xn--p1ai}}</ref> He was a professor at the [[MSU Faculty of Political Science]].<ref name="auto1"/> He was the Deputy Director of the [[S.I. Vavilov Institute for the History of Science and Technology RAS]].<ref name="auto2">{{Cite web | title=Сергей Кара-Мурза: «Социализм был эффективен как проект людей, испытавших беду» | url=https://www.business-gazeta.ru/article/528281 | access-date=2025-11-16 | website=Business-gazeta.ru | date=18 October 2025 }}</ref> He also directed the Center for the Study of Crisis Society.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.svoboda.org/a/27297269.html|title=Угроза красного реванша|first=Ксения|last=Кириллова|work=Радио Свобода |date=8 November 2015|publisher=Svoboda.org}}</ref>
He is the author of the book ''[[Soviet Civilization]]''.<ref>{{cite web | title=Ленин и семья Кара-Мурзы | url=https://www.svoboda.org/a/25236397.html }}</ref>
== Life and career ==
His mother was from [[Semirechye]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://situation.ru/app/rs/books/sovok/sovok2.htm|title="Совок" вспоминает свою жизнь|website=situation.ru}}</ref> When he was in the fifth grade of school, he was awarded a trip to [[Artek (camp)|Artek]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://situation.ru/app/rs/books/sovok/sovok9.htm|title="Совок" вспоминает свою жизнь|website=situation.ru}}</ref>
He graduated in chemistry from [[Moscow State University]] in 1961 ([[MSU Faculty of Chemistry]]).<ref name="auto"/> He was a volunteer in the [[Virgin Lands campaign]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://scriptares.ru/store/Kara-Murza/Life%20memories/sovok15.htm|title=Ñåðãåé Êàðà-Ìóðçà «Ñîâîê» âñïîìèíàåò ñâîþ æèçíü|accessdate=29 October 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://scriptares.ru/store/Kara-Murza/Life%20memories/sovok16.htm|title=Ñåðãåé Êàðà-Ìóðçà «Ñîâîê» âñïîìèíàåò ñâîþ æèçíü|accessdate=29 October 2026}}</ref>
In 1966 he defended his [[Candidate of Sciences|Candidat]] dissertation.<ref name="auto3"/> Between 1966 and 1972 he worked as a Soviet chemical specialist in [[Cuba]].<ref>{{Cite web | title=Сергей Кара-Мурза: «Кубинцы говорили: придут молодые и продадут нас, как Горбачев – вас...» | url=https://www.business-gazeta.ru/article/330706 | access-date=2025-11-16 | website=Business-gazeta.ru | date=4 December 2016 }}</ref><ref name="auto5">{{cite web | title=История одного города | url=https://echofm.online/archive/historyofcity/70322 }}</ref> After working in Cuba, he shifted to the humanities (studied issues of science policy).<ref>{{cite web | title=Умер публицист и левый идеолог Сергей Кара-Мурза | date=18 October 2025 | url=https://daily.afisha.ru/news/103095-umer-publicist-i-levyy-ideolog-sergey-kara-murza/ }}</ref><ref>{{cite web | title=«Дорога понимания»: Ответ читателю Андрею, желающему рассуждать здраво | date=2 February 2022 | url=https://vnnews.ru/expressnews/doroga-ponimaniya-otvet-chitatelyu-a/ }}</ref>

In 1968–1990 he worked at the [[S.I. Vavilov Institute for the History of Science and Technology RAS]].<ref name="auto2"/>
In 1983 Kara-Murza defended his doctoral thesis in history of science and technology and in 1988 became a professor.<ref name="auto3"/>

Kara-Murza taught in Russia and Spain and authored several publications and academic studies dedicated to history, science and society.

His most prominent works were ''Mind Manipulations,'' published in 2000, and dedicated to establishing and describing the problem of manipulation of public opinion by pro-Western mass media in Russia;<ref>{{cite book | title=The Russian Military Today and Tomorrow: Essays in Memory of Mary Fitzgerald | date=2010 | publisher=Strategic Studies Institute, U.S. Army War College | isbn=978-1-58487-449-2 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=ixsXAQAAMAAJ&pg=PA287 }}</ref> and ''[[Soviet Civilization]]'', a work about history, political and economic organization of the [[USSR]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.svoboda.org/a/umer-avtor-knigi-manipulyatsiya-soznaniem-sergey-kara-murza-/33563529.html|title=Умер автор книги "Манипуляция сознанием" Сергей Кара-Мурза|website=Svoboda.org |date=18 October 2025 }}</ref> In the late 1990s and early 2000s Sergey Kara-Murza wrote a number of political and philosophical works on [[Eurocentrism]], [[Globalization]] and [[Color revolution]]s. His articles were frequent in left-wing/nationalist Russian newspapers such as ''[[Pravda]]'', [[Alexander Prokhanov]]'s ''[[Zavtra]]'' and ''[[Soviet Russia (newspaper)|Soviet Russia]]''.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.gazeta.ru/social/2025/10/18/21882782.shtml|title=«Совесть народная». Умер Сергей Кара-Мурза|date=21 October 2025|website=Газета.Ru}}</ref>
He has also published in [[Literaturnaya gazeta]],<ref name="lgz"/> [[Nash Sovremennik]],<ref>{{cite web | title=Прямая речь | url=https://echofm.online/archive/speech/86408 }}</ref> Russkiy Dom<!--Q4400755-->.<ref>{{cite web | title=AGDchan | url=https://t.me/Agdchan/23735 }}</ref>
He was a member of the [[Union of Writers of Russia]].<ref name="auto5"/>

==Political views==
He was greatly influenced by [[Maxim Gorky]].<ref name="lgz">{{cite web | title=Ушёл глубокий мыслитель | date=21 October 2025 | url=https://lgz.ru/article/ushyel-glubokiy-myslitel/}}</ref>

Kara-Murza became known for his [[anti-globalization]], [[anti-liberal]] and [[Anti-Western sentiment|anti-Westernist]] views; however, he also rejected traditional [[Marxism-Leninism|Marxist]] ideology. He sharply criticized the Russian economic reforms of the 1990s; he was in favor of a more [[Collectivism and individualism|collectivist]] economy. Having supported President Putin's policies he was opposed to '[[color revolution]]s'.{{citation needed|date=May 2009}}

His theory that the [[golden billion]], the population of the most developed countries (including the poor) lives off the rest of humanity, is popular in the Russian-speaking world.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.svoboda.org/a/zolotoy-milliard-darjya-provotorova---o-pautine-konspirologii/32386687.html|title=Золотой миллиард. Дарья Провоторова – о паутине конспирологии|first=Дарья|last=Провоторова|work=Радио Свобода |date=6 May 2023|publisher=Svoboda.org}}</ref><ref>{{cite book | title=Russia's Visionaries: Direct Speech | date=25 November 2020 | publisher=Cambridge Scholars | isbn=978-1-5275-6279-0 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=BWQOEAAAQBAJ&pg=PA18 }}</ref><ref>{{cite news | title=How Vladimir Putin uses the "golden billion" anti-Russian conspiracy theory – the Washington Post | newspaper=[[The Washington Post]] | url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2022/07/22/putin-golden-billion-russia/ | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220814092314/https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2022/07/22/putin-golden-billion-russia/ | archive-date=14 August 2022 }}</ref> He also recognized the [[Dulles' Plan]].<ref>{{cite book | title=Putinism: Russia and Its Future in the West | date=4 June 2024 | publisher=Macmillan | isbn=978-1-4668-7106-9 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=QEfABQAAQBAJ&pg=PT75 }}</ref>

He criticized Prokhanov and [[Kurginyan]].<ref>{{Cite web | title=Сергей КАРА-МУРЗА: Музей СССР должен быть направлен в будущее Улпресса - все новости Ульяновска | url=https://ulpressa.ru/2012/12/23/sergey-kara-murza-muzey-sssr-dolzhen-byit-napravlen-v-budushhee/ | access-date=2025-11-16 | website=ulpressa.ru | date=23 December 2012 }}</ref> [[Vladimir Menshov]] described Sergey Kara-Murza as a "deep thinker",<ref>{{cite web | last1=Ремизова | first1=Мария | title=Владимир Меньшов: Задача каждого человека - обрывать невидимую цепочку зла | date=5 July 2021 | url=https://www.kp.ru/daily/28299/4439675/ }}</ref> and "irresistibly logical".<ref>{{cite web | title=Кинопресса.ру – официальный сайт Гильдии киноведов и кинокритиков России | url=http://kinopressa.ru/news/948.html | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120126221959/http://kinopressa.ru/news/948.html | archive-date=26 January 2012 }}</ref>

His works were recommended by [[Aleksandr Dugin]].<ref>{{cite web | title=Умер социолог Сергей Кара-Мурза — дядя оппозиционного политика и «учитель» Прилепина | url=https://vot-tak.tv/89535826/sergei-kara-murza }}</ref>

==Personal life and death==
Kara-Murza was related to [[Vladimir A. Kara-Murza]] and [[Vladimir V. Kara-Murza]],<ref name="auto3"/><ref>{{cite web | last1=Велехов | first1=Леонид | title=Владимир Кара-Мурза младший: "Прятаться и убегать я не буду" | work=Радио Свобода | date=8 February 2016 | url=https://www.svoboda.org/a/27519190.html }}</ref> via his grandfather, {{ill|lt=Sergey Georgyevich Kara-Murza|Sergey Kara-Murza (theatre critic)|ru|Кара-Мурза, Сергей Георгиевич (1878—1956)}}.

According to his son, Kara-Murza died on the night of 17–18 October 2025.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.kp.ru/online/news/6626503/|title=«Одним из первых поставил диагноз либерализму»: ушел из жизни Сергей Кара-Мурза, выдающийся социолог |website=Kp.ru|access-date=29 October 2026}}</ref>
[[Gennady Zyuganov|Zyuganov]] published his obituary.<ref>{{cite web | title=Памяти Сергея Георгиевича Кара-Мурзы — Газета "Советская Россия" | date=20 October 2025 | url=https://sovross.ru/2025/10/20/pamyati-sergeya-georgievicha-kara-murzy/ }}</ref>

Sergey Kara-Murza is buried at the [[Khovanskoye Cemetery]].<ref>https://moscow-tombs.ru/by-years/kara-murza_sg/</ref>

==Summaries==
Source:<ref>{{cite web | title=№11.2025. Рустем Вахитов. Антология советского разума | url=https://belprost.ru/articles/publitsistika/2025-11-13/11-2025-rustem-vahitov-antologiya-sovetskogo-razuma-4465273|website=Belprost.ru}}</ref>

The books of his listed below have been reprinted many times.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.gazeta.ru/auth/sso.shtml?origin=/social/2025/10/18/21882782.shtml|title=Document|website=Gazeta.ru}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | title=Светлой памяти С.Г. Кара-Мурзы (23.01.1939-18.10.2025)… — ИСПИ ФНИСЦ РАН | url=https://www.испи.рф/светлой-памяти-с-г-кара-мурзы-1939-2025/|website=испи.рф/светлой-памяти-с-г-кара-мурзы-1939-2025 }}</ref> These books were also bestsellers.<ref>{{cite web | title=«Угас светильник разума»: умер публицист Сергей Кара-Мурза | date=18 October 2025 | url=https://riamo.ru/news/obschestvo/ugas-svetilnik-razuma-umer-publitsist-sergej-kara-murza/ }}</ref>

===''Manipulation of Consciousness (2000)''===
Kara-Murza's magnum opus.<ref>{{cite book | title=The Patriotism of Despair: Nation, War, and Loss in Russia | date=23 February 2011 | publisher=Cornell University Press | isbn=978-0-8014-5786-9 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=csRzugw-W2UC&pg=PA45 }}</ref>
The author demonstrated the extent to which external factors influence the psychology of society.<ref name="auto4">{{cite web | title="Это самый великий по мудрости, интеллекту человек уходящей эпохи" | date=22 October 2025 | url=https://kam.business-gazeta.ru/article/685922 }}</ref>

===''[[Soviet Civilization]] (2001)''===
Another landmark work by the philosopher.<ref name="auto4"/>
The book was included by [[Eksmo]] Publishing House in the book series “Classics of Russian Thought”.<ref>{{cite web | title=Советская цивилизация. От начала до наших дней (Сергей Кара-Мурза) // Буквоед| url=https://www.bookvoed.ru/product/sovetskaya-tsivilizatsiya-1538055 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ihim.uran.ru/netcat_files/userfiles/S_KaraMurza_SSSR.pdf |format=PDF|title=Сергей Кара-Мурза: «Социализм был эффективен как проект людей, испытавших беду»|website=Ihim.uran.ru|access-date=29 October 2026}}</ref>

===''Lost Mind (2005)''===
One of the author's fundamental publicistic works.<ref>{{cite web | title=Памяти Сергея Георгиевича Кара-Мурзы — Факультет политологии | url=https://polit.msu.ru/2025/10/21/memory-kara-murza/ }}</ref>
The author reflects on the state of contemporary Russian society.<ref>{{cite web | title=Кара-Мурза Сергей / Потерянный разум. Интеллигенция на пепелище России | url=https://urss.ru/cgi-bin/db.pl?lang=Ru&blang=ru&page=Book&id=226441 }}</ref>

===''The Dismantlement of a People (2007)''===
The book is dedicated to the crisis in Russia over the last few decades.<ref>{{cite web | title=Наш демонтаж | url=https://www.stoletie.ru/kultura/nash_demontazh_2007-05-17.htm }}</ref>
